objective: S = 0.5 * ((loss - perfect_demand_floor) / history_scale + credits / budget); the prompt states the equivalent objective without the action-independent floor.
interval_method: Paired domain-stratified authority/station cluster bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, 50 electricity authorities and 20 stations; conditional on the evaluated dates; not adjusted for multiple comparisons.
scope: Hosted full pool only. TSFM removal claims apply to local configurations. Incomplete cells do not receive scores or ranking.
